title: Chilled Buckwheat and Naengmyeon Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing summer salad featuring chilled buckwheat and naengmyeon noodles, perfect for hot days.
instructions: Cook the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions.
Cook the buckwheat according to package instructions.
Chill the cooked buckwheat in the refrigerator.
Cut the chilled rice into small pieces.
Stir-fry your choice of vegetables and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked naengmyeon noodles, chilled buckwheat, and chilled rice.
Add the stir-fried vegetables and toss everything together.
Add the Korean chili flakes and light soy sauce if using, and toss again.
Serve the salad chilled and enjoy!
